title: Fabulous and enjoyable
text: We had a fabulous trip with Captain Alberto and Tatiana. The boat is in excellent condition and well maintained. We sailed along the coast from the marina. Beautiful views from the ocean. We sat watching the sunset drinking ice cold white wine. I would recommend this trip if you enjoy a relaxing boat trip with stunning views.
author: D3rks

title: Lovely sunset
text: A wonderful family day thanks to Granada Sailing and Alberto. Everything perfect, the boat super nice and the sunset beautiful. Very attentive with everything, background music and spectacular views. I'd definitely repeat. Thanks for the little while.
author: Jet08884972318

title: Unforgettable
text: We have repeated again experience pq we wanted to see the beautiful sunset of La Herradura from a sailboat. It has been amazing, the setting is wonderful and with the sunset light is something we can never forget. Thanks to Granada Sailing for treating us so well and the captain for that musicon!!!!
author: dovitina

title: Freedom and fun with a great seafaring professional. Top
text: It was an amazing experience, an unbeatable deal. Albert made the experience very enjoyable, the views were beautiful throughout the tour. Very fun and at the same time relaxing. I would totally recommend it. My friends and I will repeat for sure. Thanks for this piece of experience...
author: mirasamarah

title: Perfect getaway
text:
Perfect getaway. The boat is beautiful and very clean. The owner very friendly and professional, always attentive to what we needed.
We were very lucky, it was a beautiful day and we enjoyed it very much.
I recommend it 100%.
author: Belen M

title: Unbeatable
text: It was an unforgettable experience, watching the sunset on the sailboat was something very exciting! Thank you also to our captain Alberto for his sympathy and kindness that made our experience even more magical! We will repeat soon!
author: beatricez965

title: Excellent experience
text: A lovely experience. We really enjoyed the boat ride, the atmosphere was very nice and the treatment excellent. Also, being able to see dolphins so close made it even more special. Undoubtedly, a highly recommended activity to have an unforgettable time.
author: P5810AGcarmenp

title: Sunset
text: Unbeatable experience. Wherever we looked, they were all postcard images. Thanks also to our captain for his kindness and sympathy. In the end, the difference is made by people and we could not have chosen better to carry out this highly recommended experience.
author: 34roc_ot

title: Wonderful sunset experience sailing in Veleri.
text: Wonderful experience sailing at sunset, the scenery is beautiful and the sailboat amazing!! I went with some friends and enjoyed it very much recommend it 100%, the sea, the sun setting while we drink something and music in the background, I will come back safe!
